verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a stagewise Account that gives access to managed-inference models with "No API keys needed". The pricing page lists a free Hobby tier with limited access to 3 standard models, and the BYOK docs confirm the account-based authentication path. Community reports of a sign-in email that never arrived and of CLI-only sign-up describe onboarding friction, not proof that account sign-in doesn't work, so they lower confidence rather than create a dispute. Missing for 10: independent confirmation that sign-up and free-tier access work smoothly, and documented free-tier usage limits beyond "limited access".

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys

citations.quote: stagewise Account — The fastest way to start. Access a large library of pre-configured models through the managed inference service. No API keys needed.
Hobby Free — Limited access to 3 standard models (Default, Quick, Smart)
